description: GHOST CRSHRIDE: the crash and the ride in one module, each played from its own sample with its own trigger and output

params.text: Sets the pitch of the crash, by the speed its sample is played at
Sets how long the crash rings
Sets the pitch of the ride, by the speed its sample is played at
Sets how long the ride rings

inputs.text: Fires the crash on a rise past 2V, and samples the accent jack at that instant
Fires the ride on a rise past 2V, and samples the accent jack at that instant
Raises the level and the accent character of a hit on either cymbal while it is high at the moment of its trigger, as Accent A, shared by the whole kit
Adds to the crash tune knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the crash decay knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the crash level knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the ride tune knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the ride decay knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the ride level knob, the whole knob range over 10V

notes: the total accent jack reads as accented while nothing is patched into it, so a voice on its own sounds at its accented level until you patch an accent gate
the accent amounts and master level come from a GHOST CTRL touching this module, or reaching it along a row of touching Ghost modules; with no controller the voice runs at its own settings
neither cymbal here reads Accent B; there is no local accent jack on this module
menu: Drive (internal saturation) — two sliders, one per cymbal, setting a saturation amount that has no knob on the panel and no CV jack
